# Draazy

> Pune's broker-free property marketplace. Rent or buy homes, plots and commercial spaces from owners, with phone numbers private until the owner approves.

## About

- [About Draazy](https://draazy.com/about): what Draazy is, how it makes money, and how to contact us.
- [How verification works](https://draazy.com/how-verification-works): how owners and listings are checked, and what Draazy Assured means.
- [Draazy vs NoBroker](https://draazy.com/compare/nobroker): plans and fees compared for Pune, each NoBroker fact linked to NoBroker's own page.

## Guides

- [Pune property blog](https://draazy.com/blog): renting, buying, owner and legal guides for Pune.
- [Pune locality guides](https://draazy.com/locality): who each area suits, getting around, and what to check before you rent or buy.

## Search

- [Homes for rent in Pune](https://draazy.com/rent/pune): owner-listed flats and houses for rent, with area and BHK pages.
- [Homes for sale in Pune](https://draazy.com/buy/pune): owner-listed flats and houses for sale, with area and BHK pages.
